sources.quote: HD 108147, also known as Tupã, is a 7th magnitude star in the constellation of Crux in direct line with and very near to the bright star Acrux or Alpha Crucis.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.3 solar radii and 1.11 solar masses (FLAME) and 6,071 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
